rows.traditional: 將 A 鋪喺 B 上面
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A pou1 hai2 B soeng6 min6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically laying or spreading one thing over another surface.

example.english: We overlay the floor with a carpet.
example.traditional: 我哋將地氈鋪喺地板上面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 dei6 zin1 pou1 hai2 dei6 baan2 soeng6 min6

rows.note: Use this when the covering conceals or fully covers what is underneath, rather than merely being laid on top.

example.english: We use a thick tablecloth to overlay the whole table.
example.traditional: 張厚枱布一鋪落去，就蓋住晒成張枱。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 hau5 toi2 bou3 jat1 pou1 lok6 heoi3 zau6 goi3 zyu6 saai3 seng4 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use this for adding a caption, graphic, filter, or other overlay to an image, video, map, or interface.

example.english: We overlay this video with subtitles, and it is much clearer.
example.traditional: 呢段片加上字幕之後，睇落清楚好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 pin3 gaa1 soeng5 zi6 mok6 zi1 hau6 tai2 lok6 cing1 co2 hou2 do1
